caption: The drawing depicts five distinct objects arranged in an organized manner on a plain, beige background. Four of the objects are rectangular with slightly ornate bottom edges, and one square-shaped object is at the center. The top two rectangular objects each have an ornamental yellow and black border surrounding a central scene: the left one depicts a house or building with trees and foliage, while the right one features a small structure on a post, possibly a birdhouse, a seated figure, and a tree. The centrally positioned square object is decorated with an intricate, symmetrical ornamental design consisting of circular and swirling motifs in brown and black tones. The bottom two rectangular objects mirror the top ones in shape and border design: the left one shows a person riding a large-wheeled bicycle, with the words "YOUNG AMERICA" at the top, while the right one illustrates two figures seated in a small boat with a sail, with a tree and architectural elements in the background. All objects are predominantly brown with varying highlights of yellow, copper, and black, appearing to be illustrated representations of metal reliefs or panels. Each object is individually spaced with no overlapping elements.
title: Young America Bank
